h1: Baan Premsiri Hotel — An Easy-Priced In-Town Stay Opposite Amnat Charoen Hospital
intro: If you've come to Amnat Charoen town on business, to visit a patient at the hospital, or just need an overnight stop without paying much, Baan Premsiri Hotel (Baan Premsiri) is a small in-town stay that fits the bill · It sits on Arun Prasoet Road, directly opposite Amnat Charoen Hospital — just across the street · Rooms have balconies, AC, a TV, free parking and free Wi-Fi, in a leafy, quiet setting · Rooms start from about THB 400/night, a straightforward choice for anyone who values an in-town location and an easy price over luxury.

body.html: Baan Premsiri Hotel, or Baan Premsiri, sits at 564 Moo 12, Arun Prasoet Road, Bung Subdistrict, Mueang Amnat Charoen — in town on the main road, directly opposite Amnat Charoen Hospital, just across the street · That location makes it a regular pick for people visiting patients, dealing with town offices, or running errands, since it's minutes from the hospital, the clock tower, the City Pillar Shrine and the town markets.

The property is a small serviced-apartment-style building · Rooms come in both twin and single-bed layouts, with simple, warm décor · What many guests like is that rooms have a private balcony you can open up for some air · Inside there's air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, and an en-suite bathroom with a shower and toiletries — enough for an overnight stay · The grounds are leafy and quiet, calmer than hotels on the bigger roads.
"Clean room with a balcony to sit out on, easy parking, and right across from the hospital — perfect for visiting relatives."

What makes it convenient for self-drivers is the free private parking and a wide lot, so there's no worry about where to leave the car · There's free Wi-Fi, a 24-hour front desk and room service, which helps a lot if you arrive late or are coming and going from the hospital at odd hours · Overall it's a simple, clean stay in a spot that's easy to get around town from.

The honest caveats — this is a plain in-town stay, not a full-facility hotel · There's no swimming pool, no on-site restaurant or gym, and no standard breakfast, so you'll head out to eat — though there are plenty of spots in town to choose from · It's a small property with limited rooms, so when there's an event in town or many hospital visitors, it can fill quickly; call ahead to book · Anyone expecting a resort feel or a brand-new hotel may find it doesn't quite match.

In short, Baan Premsiri suits anyone wanting an in-town Amnat Charoen stay near the hospital and markets at an easy price, for business, visiting a patient, or an overnight stop · The draw is the in-town location, rooms with balconies, free parking and quiet at an accessible price · Set your expectations for a simple, value-focused stay and most guests rest comfortably for what they pay.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Baan Premsiri Hotel, Amnat Charoen

faq.q: Where is Baan Premsiri in Amnat Charoen?
faq.a: It's at 564 Moo 12, Arun Prasoet Road, Bung Subdistrict, Mueang Amnat Charoen, in town and directly opposite Amnat Charoen Hospital · Near Wat Thep Mongkhon (~0.5 km), the clock tower, City Pillar Shrine and town markets.

faq.q: What's the starting price and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from about THB 400/night for a single · There are twin/double rooms around THB 500 and Superior rooms around THB 600 · Monthly serviced-apartment rooms are also available — ask the property directly · Prices vary by season, so call to check before booking.

faq.q: What are the rooms like — what's in them?
faq.a: Rooms have simple, warm décor with a private balcony, AC, flat-screen TV and an en-suite bathroom with a shower and toiletries · The grounds are leafy and quiet, good for a simple overnight stay.
There is free private parking and a wide lot, handy for self-drivers · There is no standard breakfast, so you head out to eat in town, where there are several spots within easy reach.

faq.q: Who is this stay best for?
faq.a: It suits anyone here on business, visiting a patient at the hospital, or stopping overnight who values an in-town location and an easy price · Less suited to those wanting a resort with a pool or a brand-new full-facility hotel.
